name: Process Mapper
problem: Every workflow starts with understanding the work, and discovery calls are messy. A pasted call transcript goes in, a structured process map comes out with the steps, stakeholders, unstated gaps, follow-up questions and a draft diagram.

name: SOP Generator
problem: Workflows fail when nobody knows how they run. A messy description of a process, typed or spoken, goes in and a numbered standard operating procedure comes out with the purpose, ordered steps, tools and exceptions. Contact details are stripped before the text reaches the model.

name: Meeting Minutes Extractor
problem: Decisions and owners get lost after a call. A transcript or a spoken recap goes in, structured minutes come out with decisions made, action items with owners and deadlines, and open questions. Nothing is stored beyond the generated minutes.

name: Executive Briefing Generator
problem: Founders drown in scattered notes, emails and to-dos. Raw fragments go in and a one page brief comes out with the top three priorities, the decisions only the founder can make, tasks to delegate and items that can wait.

name: Cold Outreach Personalizer
problem: Outbound stalls when every prospect gets the same email. A batch of prospects goes in, a tailored 3-touch sequence comes out for each one, so reply rates are not capped by how long personalization takes.

name: Investor Update Drafter
problem: Founders skip investor updates when the numbers are messy, and investors lose the thread. Raw metrics and bullets go in, a clean update comes out with a numeric sanity check built in.

name: Automation Priority Sorter
problem: Teams automate whatever is loudest, not whatever frees the most time. Submit a manual pain point, it gets scored in real time and ranked in a shared backlog.
